【Abstract · abstract-1-6】The proposed framework is compared with various state-of-the-art models in terms of classification accuracy, model parameters, and layer sizes.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】The proposed framework achieved remarkable average precision, recall, and accuracy values of 99.35%, 99.30%, and 99.22%, respectively, through five-fold cross-validation.
